{{Quote|Capitol Square has Republic and Imperial soldiers. All fighting. No Guardian Hold One. A Republic checkpoint is close. They may help. I send the position to everyone.|Tasan-Ge|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tasan-Ge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] and member of the entourage of the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Gaden-Ko]]. Gaden-Ko's entourage served in the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], and Tasan-Ge scouted the situation in [[Capitol Square]], though he was injured in the process.
